curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8273-1-1.pdf and 8273-1-2.pdf (books 1/2 and 2/2: functions on book 1 pages 2-3, steps 1-68); books 3 and 4 build the alternate model (8273-2)

functions.does: The gear on the cab roof steers the front wheels: its shaft runs down through the cab to a knob gear that meshes with the chassis's knob gear, whose 8-tooth pinion drives the rack behind the front axle.
functions.source: book: 1 page 2 (arrows on the roof gear and front wheels); book 1 steps 1-17 (front axle, rack and pinion), book 2 cab steps 16 and 63

functions.does: The cab tilts forward on its pivot at the front of the chassis, taking the roof gear's shaft out of mesh with the steering.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (arrow over the cab); book 2 step 63 (the cab's pivot pins)

functions.does: The gear knob at the front bumper winds the winch, pulling in or paying out the hook on its string.
functions.source: book: 1 page 2 (hook and arrow at the front), page 3 (2 m); book 2 front winch steps 1-8 (pages 38-39)

functions.does: The rear of the two gear knobs on the chassis's left side slews the crane round on its turntable, all the way round.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (360 degrees), step 32 (green arrows on the turntable and the rear knob)

functions.does: The front of the two gear knobs on the chassis's left side raises and lowers the crane's red arm: a shaft up through the turntable's middle turns a worm, which turns the 24-tooth crown gear on the arm's pivot.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (up arrow on the crane); book 1 steps 29-32 (knobs), book 2 steps 52-53 (crown gear and worm shaft)

functions.does: The gear knob at the top of the red arm folds the black jib up and down: it turns a worm inside the arm, which drives an 8-tooth gear and a linkage to the jib.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (curved arrow at the jib); book 2 steps 54 (worm shaft in the arm), 58 (green arrow on the knob), 59-60 (jib)

functions.does: The fork hangs from the jib's end and stays level as the crane moves, carrying the tan load.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (arrow at the load); book 2 steps 61-62
functions.note: hangs under gravity: the fork p492 6629 and the load p501 3701

functions.does: The gear knob low on the right side, behind the cab, tips the grey bed: its shaft's crank, an offset axle joiner in the middle of the frame, pushes the bed's front up through a lever and links, the bed pivoting at its back end.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (curved arrow over the bed, the bed shown tipped); book 1 steps 19-24 (crank shaft and links), 41-47 (bed); inferred: which knob, from the model

functions.does: The tailgate at the back of the bed swings open.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (curved arrow at the tailgate); book 1 step 45

functions.does: The four rear wheels are on a bogie that rocks on one cross axle through the frame, so both rear axles stay on the ground over bumps.
functions.source: inferred: book 1 step 34 (inset: the bogie hangs on one axle at the frame's middle); not shown moving

functions.does: The six wheels roll freely; nothing drives them.
A second 8-tooth gear meshes with the 8-tooth gear on the winch drum's other end, a brake that holds the hook where it is left.
functions.source: inferred: from the parts beside the winch drum (book 2 front winch steps); what it is for is a guess
functions.skip: a brake only resists gravity; the winch works both ways without it
